articles.title: Bitcoin rises above $81,000, while NEAR jumps 23% on Zcash swap traffic
articles.snippet: Bitcoin extended a slow climb through the Asian session while regional equities and U.S. stock futures rose on progress in trade talks between Washington and Beijing.

articles.title: Crypto traders braced for a total wipeout this week but Bitcoin had other plans
articles.snippet: Market experts view bitcoin’s price stability as evidence of its fundamental independence from Washington, maintaining that global liquidity and adoption cycles remain the primary growth drivers.

articles.title: Security Experts Want the US and China to Promise Never to Let AI Control Nukes
articles.snippet: Brookings researchers in the US and China are urging Washington and Beijing to agree to keep humans in control of nuclear weapons.
